name: Introduction and overview — F-8 Crusader — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — F-8 Crusader
description: Introduction and overview of the F-8 Crusader: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The F-8 Crusader is a single-engine carrier-based fighter built by Vought, entering service in 1957. Its variable-incidence wing tilted up for carrier landings. The 'last of the gunfighters' earned 19-to-3 kill ratio in Vietnam. 1,219 were built; France flew the type until 1999. Baseline facts: Carrier-based fighter; service from 1957; 1,219 built by Vought; variable-incidence wing..
